props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for label-less usage. A range joins it to each thumb's name.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged onto the root via `cn`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value. An array of two or more numbers renders one thumb per entry; a one-number array is read as that number. It is read on mount and again on a native form reset, as React reads its own inputs' defaults.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error copy, rendered as `Field.Error` when truthy. Accepts any `ReactNode`. Falsy, the field shows its own validation error instead.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Formatting options for the shown value and each thumb's `aria-valuetext`, forwarded as base-ui `format`. Locale comes from the provider.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Forwards `disabled` to `Field.Root` and `Slider.Root`; the thumb shows the disabled state face.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Forwards `invalid` to `Field.Root`; the thumb shows the invalid state face.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, rendered as `Field.Label`; it names the thumb of a single-value slider.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: Step for PageUp, PageDown and Shift with an arrow. Defaults to 10.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Upper bound, forwarded as base-ui `max`. Defaults to 100.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Lower bound, forwarded as base-ui `min`. Defaults to 0.

props.name: name
props.description: Native `name` forwarded to the primitive, so the value submits with a form.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every change while it moves. A range keeps the shape of `value`, with each element widened to `number`. A native form reset does not call it.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout axis. A vertical slider fills its parent's height, and its control below the label row keeps at least 160px.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the formatted value at the end of the label row; a range joins its values with an en dash.

props.name: step
props.description: Step for the arrow keys and the snap grid, counted from `minValue`. Defaults to 1.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names of a range's thumbs, by index. Defaults to the locale dictionary's minimum and maximum, joined to `label` or `aria-label`. A single thumb takes its name from `label` or `aria-label` instead.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. `Value` is a `number`, or an array of at least two numbers with one value per thumb for a range. A one-number array from untyped code is read as that number, so `onChange` reports a number. `undefined`, passed or omitted, is uncontrolled, as with React's own inputs.
